scope: Android293 official frozen source, target-free read-only; no official execution, native-session use or product edits
confirmed_entry: Remote file-reference events rdk/mdk/pdk/qdk -> r5k -> g4k -> f4k state -> materialized ukl preview. Not evidence for a Remote toolbar Files directory browser.
identity: Retain full original reference g4k(jik,key), source host/thread/environment from o5k; materialized local path is distinct from reference remote URL/path. Close resets state and cancels retained jobs; replacement must use exact requested identity in independent adapter. Complete original race guards not audited.
html_boundary: by81.g disables file/content access. Without lik snapshot network loads blocked and JS/DOM storage disabled; with snapshot these enabled under custom eak interceptor. eak classifies resource/main-frame links; some links emit new mdk reference callback. Do not substitute unrestricted WebView or attach file:// permission. Cloud localhost snapshot request explicitly rejected.
ordinary_browser: General URL fallback dnc0 -> zq81.m -> od81.c constructs Custom Tabs intent; b871 starts resolved external browser package and bo50 tracks open/close. This supports Android browser-hosted custom tab, not proof of a universal in-app WebView shell. Ads/merchant and HTML preview have separate owners.
minimum_independent_contract: Separate Remote file reference identity and source host context from ordinary uploaded attachments and Library.
Preview loading/error/ready/unsupported by exact request identity; keep local cache path distinct from display/remote path.
Text/image preview may use native primitives; HTML snapshot behavior needs separate declared adapter, lifecycle and network policy.
Ordinary HTTP(S) browser route can use platform Custom Tabs. Preserve origin conversation route on return; exact original close/back visual controls not recovered.
A directory browser can only be labelled independent fixture until its actual Android293 toolbar entry/tree owner is proven.
unresolved: Remote right-top Files entry -> directory tree has not been established. No directory-list request/recursive tree owner was recovered; _782 Files is file-change summary. Do not add sidebar Files from this evidence.
Complete read-file service protocol, download acknowledgment, path normalization/traversal and MIME limits unclosed. An fs/readFile search hit oa0 is pet-file reading and intentionally excluded.
Full snapshot URL allowlist/interceptor branches have JADX warnings; only WebView enable/disable flags corroborated with smali, no claim of complete network enforcement recovery.
Ordinary Custom Tabs close/back implementation belongs platform browser; exact toolbar styling, redirects, third-party schemes and account cookie policy unverified.
Generic file preview ns61 (including PDF) and Library routes were found but not proven Remote a4k preview capabilities; do not import PDF capability merely by shared filename.
